scope: IDs12/30/31; photo19 WARP subsection; final phone operations owned exclusively by coordinator

local_peer_command.command: go run -mod=readonly -ldflags=-checklinkname=0 ./cmd/WireGuardPeer -version awg2 -endpoint <local/private IP reachable by coordinator test client> -output <new private absolute directory>
local_peer_command.behavior: Fresh private keys, ephemeral UDP, exclusive client.conf. ready event returns nonce-path url +url_ipv6 +expected_body; both HTTP listeners inside tunnel; correct path only200. STOP/5min closes server/device and emits sanitized closed handshake/RX/TX/request/body-byte receipt. No raw IPC/private-key output. Keep stdin open.

required_exact_libbox_gates: Import generated client.conf using WireGuardProfile/ServerImport; assert all keys/AllowedIPs/profileDns/native fields survive share, link and QR roundtrip. Use coordinator's own libbox isolated probe (no second tunnel implementation in production).

Libbox.checkConfig on WG, AWG1, AWG2, AWG3 header key, AWG3 ranged keepalive, AWG3.1 flags/timers, CPS, invalid CPS, invalid reversed ranges and too-short S1-S4 with header key. Unsupported capabilities must raise a readable error, never silently downgrade.

For WG/AWG1/AWG2, connect candidate via actual Android libbox to local fixture peer and fetch returned internal HTTP URL. Compare random expected_body exactly. This is private test traffic, not Internet/WARP proof.

Repeat in proxy and VPN modes; stop/restart; Wi-Fi/mobile/network-change; background/Doze; revoke permission; assert port/process/TUN cleanup and no stale auto selection. Do not interrupt existing user VPN/probe; coordinate test window centrally.

Verify allowed routes, IPv4/IPv6, DNS profile override against selected DNS policy and direct/bypass priorities; test unreachable peer/incorrect key/incorrect obfuscation and cancellation. Local peer intentionally exposes HTTP only, not a DNS service.

AWG3/3.1 live peer is NOT provided by WarpScout's older pinned v0.2.20 library. Coordinator must use its already pinned exact sing-box-lx native implementation on both fixture sides or explicitly authorized compatible test peer, without changing app backend or transport pins. Retain gate pending until true handshake/body evidence exists.
warp_flow: Register only on user action after provider terms, via WarpOperations.register(WarpScanner). No account registration was performed by this owner.

Use WarpOperations.scan with Options from WarpSettingsStore. Supply TunnelTrace that builds an isolated probe for exactly candidate config and requests HTTPS https://www.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace through that probe; close candidate in finally. Never use system/direct fetch and never disconnect user's active VPN to probe.

Test WG/AWG/auto, any/foreign/fixed country, excluded DME, extended search, unavailable country, corrupted result, module missing/signature/ABI error, cancel, retry and deletion while scan is running.

Only Verified result is eligible for replacement: under coordinator operation/generation guard, confirm previous ID still exists, catalogue.saveWarp(verified.account,verified.server.original,previousId), update selection to returned new ID. A failed or cancelled trace retains original selected profile and account.

Encrypted catalogue already owns account/key storage and deletes linked account on local profile removal. Register warpOptions backup validator before backup/restore; confirm local/WebDAV roundtrip and old-backup defaults. Local deletion must not claim remote Cloudflare revocation.
evidence_required: Generated fixture key provenance without publishing private keys
limits: Loopback Go fixtures prove pinned WarpScout WG/AWG1/2 handshake, HTTP transfer and down/up; they do not prove Android libbox, provider WARP availability, external DNS or AWG3/3.1 compatibility.
coordinator_android_probe_hook: Off main thread, no catalogue write: val entry=ServerImport.read(privateFixtureConf).single(); val result=ProbeCoordinator.measure(context,listOf(entry),ready.url,ProbeCoordinator.cancellationToken()); require(result[entry.id] != null && result[entry.id]!! >= 0). Repeat ready.url_ipv6. Coordinator only, shared probe idle. Exact Android core hash/ABI plus closed peer receipt handshake_observed=true, rx_bytes>0, tx_bytes>0, http_requests>=2 and body bytes>=2*expected_body.length prove tunnel traffic. Probe alone does NOT verify VPN routes/DNS/lifecycle.
